parts.label: (a)
parts.note: Both show 6 x 1176 = 2^4 x 3^2 x 7^2 = 84^2 with every index even; moderator confirms 7056 = 84^2.

parts.label: (b)
parts.note: Both give n = 147; moderator confirms 1176/147 = 8 = 2^3 and no smaller n divides 1176 to a cube (the only cube divisors are 1 and 8).

key_verdict: No disagreement; the setter's key is correct on both parts.
why: Exact SEAB phrasing ('Written as a product of its prime factors', 'cube number', 'Explain why'), 1+1 mark discipline at the Q4 slot, and the two twists (multiply by 6 before the perfect-square check; divide rather than multiply to reach a cube) keep it off 2023 Q4(a) and 2025 Q10(b) while staying inside the annual prime-factor genre.
